- We have an early-pay program but need to confirm internal eligibility for the discount (2%/10 sounds reasonable to discuss).

Thanks Marissa / Dana.

Laura from Finance here — checklist for vendor setup and Net 60 exception:
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (we need legal name, remit address, and bank remit/payment instructions).
2) W9 (received).
3) Vendor risk questionnaire (I will send a short form).
4) Estimated monthly spend and contract length.

Notes on payment terms:
- Our standard is Net 30.
- Net 60 requires a commercial justification and a manager sign-off (we route exceptions through FIN ticket FIN-2741).
- If procurement approves Net 60, we require a documented early-pay term for AR optimization (2%/10 acceptable; please confirm).

Please do not send invoices until the vendor record is active and a PO is issued. Once we have the completed forms I will create the vendor in the system and open the exception request.

I will attach the vendor risk questionnaire in a follow-up and open FIN-2741 once we get the completed form and spend estimate.
